transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this coverage huddle to order. As you know, the Advanced Chemistry teacher will be absent for three consecutive school days next month, and I need to approve both the coverage roster and the instructional plan before anything gets posted to staff. We have a draft plan on the table that uses one substitute, regular classroom activities, and the standard make-up-work process. Before I review it for approval, I'd like to hear from each of you — department chair, HR coordinator, nurse, and counselor — on any relevant updates that might affect this plan. Let's start with the department chair.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue with the draft plan. My department calendar shows that the class's graded chemistry lab practical is scheduled for the second day of the absence, and it cannot be replaced by a worksheet. Department policy requires a chemistry-certified teacher to supervise it. I entered the practical in the department calendar this week, but I had not yet forwarded the calendar note to Ms. Morgan, so she may not have been aware of this when the draft was prepared.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an important update from the HR side. I verified in the substitute credential and availability system that Dr. Lena Park is the only available substitute with a current chemistry certificate, and she is available for all three absence days. However, the staffing roster has not yet been updated with that verification.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a health and safety concern. A student in the Advanced Chemistry class has an active seizure action plan that requires an adult trained in seizure response to remain in the classroom during laboratory activities. I confirmed both the seizure action plan and the training records this week, and Dr. Lena Park's training record is current — she is trained in seizure response. However, I have not yet attached these records to the coverage request, so they weren't part of the draft plan review.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a student support concern. One student in the Advanced Chemistry class is the primary after-school caregiver for a younger sibling and cannot use the school's online make-up portal during these three absence days. I confirmed this in a family meeting and recorded the request in my counseling file, but I have not yet sent it to the classroom teacher. This student needs a printed make-up packet available before the absence begins.
transcript.speaker: A5
